name: job-intelligence-radar-v2
description: Self-hostable job and client-lead discovery radar for Cloudflare Workers, D1 and Workers AI

scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run check:architecture && npm test
scripts.pretest:runtime: npm run config:generate && npm run build:check

INBOX_PASSWORD.description: **Recommended:** choose a unique strong password (at least 16 characters) for your Radar Inbox. The browser interface stays locked until this secret is configured. Do not use your GitHub or Cloudflare password.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: **Recommended:** a separate randomly generated token for administrative API calls. Never commit it to GitHub or share it publicly. In terminal use `openssl rand -hex 32` to generate one.
